# SOMEWHERE — Travel Planner App

> SOMEWHERE is a travel planner app for iOS, iPadOS, Android, macOS, and visionOS. The SOMEWHERE travel planner app brings AI trip itineraries, day-by-day route maps, expense tracking and 50-currency settlement, shared and private packing lists, and offline travel vouchers into one planning flow, and lets friends collaborate across iPhone and Android. Available in Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German and Spanish.

The SOMEWHERE travel planner app (여행 계획 앱 "SOMEWHERE", developed by NP) is not a booking service. It is a trip planning app: travelers build an itinerary with AI or manually, view each day's route on Google Maps, log shared or private trip expenses, manage packing checklists, store flight and hotel vouchers, and share the trip with companions. The app is free to download on the App Store and Google Play; optional SOMEWHERE PRO subscriptions provide additional capacity and features, so free download does not mean every feature is free.

## Features

- [AI itinerary](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/ai/): In the SOMEWHERE travel planner app, pick a destination, dates, companions and trip type, and AI builds a day-by-day itinerary. Refine stops, swap indoor spots for rainy days, or optimize visiting order by chatting with Edit with AI.
- [Route map & large screens](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/map/): Places added to the itinerary are numbered and connected on Google Maps in visiting order for each day. Includes place search, importing single places and public lists from Google Maps, turn-by-turn Google Maps directions handoff, and side-by-side layouts optimized for iPads, tablets, and foldables.
- [Expense splitting & AI receipt scan](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/expense/): Log trip expenses in 50 currencies (up to 3 per trip with automatic or host-set rates), scan receipts or payment photos with Fill with AI, mark personal spending as Private expense (hidden from trip mates and excluded from settlement), manage a shared fund, view category statistics, export CSV (SOMEWHERE PRO), and see a clear settlement summary of who owes whom.
- [Plan together](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/together/): Invite friends across iPhone and Android by 24-hour link or QR code to collaborate on the same itinerary, map and expenses. Link joiners start with view-only access, and the host sets per-friend itinerary and expense edit permissions.
- [Packing list](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/packing/): Each trip in the SOMEWHERE travel planner app has a shared packing list for the group and a private packing list per trip mate, with one-tap common essentials, reusable copy/paste across trips, and offline viewing of lists opened before.
- [Vouchers & tickets](https://npsomewhere.com/en/features/vouchers/): Save flight, train, bus, ferry, hotel stay and entry vouchers with photos or PDFs, use Fill with AI to extract booking codes and dates, link tickets to itinerary places and expenses, open them from the current trip card, filter by holder or "Mine only", hide private vouchers (SOMEWHERE PRO), and open loaded vouchers offline.
- [Live Activities, weather & trip duplication](https://npsomewhere.com/en/): Check weather forecasts on upcoming trip date cards, duplicate a past trip (including its packing lists) to plan a similar one, and follow the active trip from the iOS Dynamic Island and Lock Screen via Live Activities or Android Live Updates · Now bar (with SOMEWHERE PRO on supported devices).
